notice: Medium Barcode 1D Collection, ArTe-Lab, University of Insubria; A. Zamberletti, I. Gallo, M. Carullo and E. Binaghi, Neural Image Restoration for Decoding 1-D Barcodes Using Common Camera Phones (2011). Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).
truth: Each photo lists its EAN-13 or UPC-A symbol, with the digits the set gives, or for the three photos it gives none for, the digits printed under the symbol, read by eye; UPC-A as its 12 digits. No photo was checked for other symbols.
